Since 0.1.10. The major version stays 0.

### Play
L1 › Play activity shows everything you played, and Y › Play time on a game shows that game alone. L2 and R2 step Week, Month, and Year. The three share one date, which stops at the first day you played and at today (#400).

Week is a row for each day across the hours. It is a calendar week from the device's first day of the week, the same week as the strip in L1. Month is a calendar shaded against your own played days. Year is twelve monthly bars, with the years you played and their time above, the shown year lit. The D-pad moves the date, and leaving a month or a year steps into the next. A line under the chart says that day's or month's time (#400).

A lists the day's sessions, and a held X removes one. On a month in Year, A opens that month. A game's page opens on the month you last played it, beside Time played, First played, Last played, Days played, Sessions, Longest, and Best streak. Y there opens Move time from. B closes a list first, then the page. The other screen names the game (#400).

A quiet period says so, as No play this week or No play in February 2025. Android apps Foldcade didn't launch keep only Android's recent usage, about a week, so their older time isn't in the history (#400).

The release asset is `foldcade.apk`.

### Known issues
- The Thor hardware checklist is open. A green emulator run is not a Thor pass. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/43
- GameNative's own library is not imported. Foldcade reads Home shortcuts and exported `.steam`, `.epic`, `.gog`, `.amazon`, and `.pcgame` files. It does not read GameNative's private database. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/100
- Android games launched from Foldcade don't record play history, so they don't appear in Recent or Most played.
